title: Design: the download menu
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'See Financial Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have invoiced part lines this month at your location, so the report has rows (for example a new work order for this test, invoiced today, with a part priced by a tier).
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Click the ⋯ button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • A menu opens under the ⋯ button with Download Summary (PDF), Download Expanded View (PDF), Download Summary (CSV) and Download Expanded View (CSV), as in picture 20.18.
  • All four items can be clicked.
